drafter.private_reasoning: The draft needs a defined settlement amount and clearer payment mechanics, a broad release effective only after payment, and workable confidentiality exceptions. Remove the internal tracked deletion before sending. Do not include the client’s confidential information in the redline or cover note.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is Delmar’s proposed first-round redline. We have clarified the payment mechanics and release, and added customary exceptions to the confidentiality provision. Please provide the proposed Settlement Amount and let us know if you have comments on the revisions.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the Settlement Amount of $[________] within [__] business days after the Effective Date, by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff. Plaintiff shall provide any reasonably necessary payment instructions. The Settlement Amount is inclusive of all amounts payable by Defendant under this Agreement.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff, for itself and its successors and assigns, irrevocably and unconditionally releases and forever discharges Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, damages, and obligations, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, that Plaintiff has or may have arising out of or relating to the facts, circumstances, or claims asserted or that could have been asserted in the action through the Effective Date. Plaintiff shall not commence or maintain any action based on a released claim.
edits.name: Release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep confidential the terms of this Agreement and the amount of the Settlement Amount, and shall not disclose them except to their respective attorneys, accountants, insurers, auditors, and other professional advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations; as reasonably necessary to implement or enforce this Agreement; or as required by law, regulation, or court order. A party required to make a disclosure shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment. Nothing in this Section prohibits either party from making truthful statements about the underlying dispute where required by law.
edits.name: Confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement and the payment of the Settlement Amount are a compromise of disputed claims and shall not constitute or be construed as an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or the validity of any claim by Defendant. Defendant denies liability.
edits.name: No Admission
